text.p: A short starter score of Kraken's own for Forged in the Dark, for a new crew of three to five scoundrels at Tier 0. It plays in one session: free play to take the job, a plan and the engagement roll, the score itself, and the first downtime.

It uses the GM's Score panel (position, effect, the engagement roll) and the Clocks window (its clocks: Counting-house Alert, The Vault Door, First Light, and The Grey Lanterns Strike if the rival gang comes). Its map, Brine Street Counting-house, has its walls and doors.
Mother Corvane of the Widow's Hand meets the crew in the back room of the Drowned Bell, a smoky canal tavern. She is old, round, and very polite.

p.i: "The Tallow Guild keeps two ledgers. One for the city's tax-men, and one for themselves. I want the second one. It sits in the vault of their counting-house on Brine Street, and tomorrow at dawn their auditors carry it away to the Upper Ward, where no one like us will ever reach it."

text.p: She offers 6 coin for the ledger, delivered to her before dawn, and +1 status with the Widow's Hand. She knows the counting-house has a night guard of four or five men under Captain Merrow Haske, a canal dock at the back, and an iron vault.
Questions to ask the players: Who among you has crossed the Tallow Guild before? Which of you knows someone who works the Brine Street docks? Why do you trust Mother Corvane, or why don't you?
A two-story brick counting-house on the canal (the map: Brine Street Counting-house). At night the lamps on the dock burn low.

list.li: The dock: cobbles, barrels, a mooring for a barge. A single door into the loading hall. One guard walks the dock every quarter hour.
The loading hall: crates of lamp-oil and candles, barrels, a lantern on a hook. Two guards dice here.
The guard room: bunks, a brazier, the alarm bell's rope. Captain Haske sleeps here, badly.
The clerks' office: desks, ink, the day ledgers (the false ones). A secret door behind a bookcase leads to the counting room.
The counting room: the master's desk, the stairs up to the Guild's apartments, and a strongbox (4 coin).
The vault: behind an iron door off the corridor (a Tier II lock). Inside: the true ledger, bound in green leather, among crates of fine wax.

text.p: Let the players choose a plan and its detail: a stealth plan (the point of infiltration: the canal dock at the tide's turn?), a deception plan (the method: as the Guild's auditors, a day early?), a social plan (the connection: bribing Captain Haske?), an assault (the point of attack). The Score panel keeps the plan, the detail and the target (the Tallow Guild, Tier II).

Engagement roll: 1d, plus a die for each major advantage (a bold plan; a detail that hits the counting-house where it is weak, like the secret door; help from a friend or contact who works the docks), minus a die for each disadvantage (a complex plan; the Grey Lanterns on the same job; a target two Tiers above the crew).
Clocks: put Counting-house Alert (6) and First Light (8) on the table as the score begins; The Vault Door (4) when the crew reaches it. Cut to the action at the first obstacle.

list.li: The night guards (a small gang, quality 2): when the alert clock fills, the bell rings, the guards gather, and the Harbor Watch sends a patrol (a medium gang) within minutes.
Captain Merrow Haske sleeps badly and wakes easily. He can be bought (2 coin) if someone reaches him before the alarm, and he hates the Guild's master.

The Grey Lanterns have heard of the ledger too. If the engagement roll is a 1-3, or a consequence calls for it, start The Grey Lanterns Strike (6) racing against First Light: when it fills, three of them break in the dock door, wanting the ledger for themselves.
The true ledger is heavy (load 2), and its last pages name a Harbor Watch magistrate who takes the Guild's money. Who else would pay for that page?

text.p: Payoff: 6 coin from Mother Corvane (the strongbox adds 4). A score against a Tier II target earns a Tier 0 crew 4 rep (2, +2 for a target two Tiers above); a score kept completely quiet earns none.
Heat: 0 if smooth and quiet, 2 if contained, 4 if loud, 6 if wild; +1 for a well-connected target (the Guild is); +2 if anyone was killed.

Faction status: the Tallow Guild -2 if they learn who did it (-1 if they only suspect); the Widow's Hand +1 (+2 if the crew also brings the magistrate's page); the Grey Lanterns -1 if the crew beat them to it.
Entanglements follow as usual. A fine follow-up: Mother Corvane asks for a second job, against the magistrate named in the ledger.

mothercorvane.name: Mother Corvane
mothercorvane.text: A round, polite old fence and broker of secrets, who never raises her voice and never forgets a debt. The crew's client.

id-00001.name: The Harbor Watch
id-00001.text: Brackwater's law on the docks and canals, for sale by the hour. Its night captains answer to whoever paid last.
id-00001.goal: Clean Up Brine Street (8): a show of order before the new magistrate arrives.

id-00002.name: The Tallow Guild
id-00002.text: The lamp-oil and candle merchants who light the city. Rich, proud, and quietly cheating the city's lamp tax.

id-00003.name: The Widow's Hand
id-00003.text: An old smuggling family turned brokers of secrets, led by Mother Corvane. They pay well and remember everything.

id-00004.name: The Grey Lanterns
id-00004.text: A young, hungry street gang that wants the Brine Street docks, and anyone's coin.

id-00001.name: Counting-house Alert
id-00001.text: The guards' suspicion. Tick it for complications; when it fills, the alarm bell rings and the Watch comes running.

id-00002.name: The Vault Door
id-00002.text: The Guild's iron vault door: a lock of Tier II quality. Tinker, Wreck, or find the key.

id-00003.name: First Light
id-00003.text: The night is short. Tick it as time passes (a long action, a flashback that takes the crew away); at dawn the clerks arrive and the job is scrubbed.

id-00004.name: The Grey Lanterns Strike
id-00004.text: A racing clock against First Light, if the GM brings in the rival gang: when it fills, the Lanterns burst in the dock door.
